title: plugin-auth: the user-import wizard's automatic invitation link is dead — admin-import-users.ts calls requestPasswordReset with no redirectTo, so the emailed link carries an empty callbackURL and lands on INVALID_TOKEN
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: #23104 · identity-auth.identity-import-wizard · C2b

**Reader who acts:** the seat owning `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` (triage routes). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "import users invitation email reset password link empty callbackURL INVALID_TOKEN requestPasswordReset redirectTo" — 0 hits.

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, admin persona. Dev log email transport. Reproduced on two separate wizard imports; source line confirmed by the PM seat.

## Reproduction

1. Setup › Users › Import → CSV `email,name` / `x@example.com,X` → Next → password policy **Automatic** → Import. Wire: `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` `{rows: [{email, name}], mode: 'insert', passwordPolicy: 'auto'}` → 200, delivery `email`.
2. Read the `sys_email` row sent to `x@example.com`: its link is `ORIGIN/api/v1/auth/reset-password/TOKEN?callbackURL=` — an **empty** `callbackURL`.
3. Open that link in a fresh browser: 302 → `/api/v1/auth/error?error=INVALID_TOKEN` → `/_console/login?error=INVALID_TOKEN`, banner "Single sign-on could not be completed — the sign-in link expired or was already used". The token itself is valid: the same token `POST`ed to `/api/v1/auth/reset-password` answers 200.

**Control:** `POST /api/v1/auth/request-password-reset` WITH `redirectTo` yields `…?callbackURL=http%3A%2F%2FHOST%2F_console%2Freset-password`, whose GET 302s to `/_console/reset-password?token=…` — the console's own forgot-password flow works.

**Expected:** the invited user lands on the set-password page.

## Mechanism (objectstack `main`)

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts:704`: `await authApi.requestPasswordReset({ body: { email: invite.email } });` — no `redirectTo`, so better-auth emits an empty `callbackURL` and its `GET /reset-password/:token` handler refuses it.

Secondary (same email): the invitation reuses the reset copy — "We received a request to reset the password… If you didn't request this, ignore this email" — sent to a user who requested nothing.
